Coastal Aesthetics is pleased to announce we are now a Biote Certified Provider! Biote is a respected hormone optimization brand with a variety of safe and natural products designed to help you live a healthy, balanced life. Our partnership with Biote marks a significant milestone in our commitment to offering the latest and most advanced treatments to help you achieve optimal well-being. With more than 80 years of scientific research, Biote has turned their knowledge into a medical protocol that may help with early signs of hormone imbalance, including fatigue, decreased sex drive, brain fog, weight gain, sleep issues, mood swings, and more. How Does Hormone Optimization Work? Hormone optimization is a medical approach that works to restore or optimize hormone levels to achieve optimal balance and improve overall well-being. Hormone optimization involves various strategies and treatments to ensure that hormones function at their best. Hormones are chemical messengers produced by various glands and tissues throughout the body. They play a crucial role in regulating multiple physiological processes and functions. Hormones act as signaling molecules that communicate between different body parts, helping coordinate and control various bodily functions. When there is an overproduction or underproduction of hormones, it can lead to hormonal imbalances, which can cause a wide range of health issues like diabetes (insulin imbalance), thyroid disorders (thyroid hormone imbalance), and menopause (estrogen and progesterone imbalance). Natural. Conservative. Beauty. Schedule Consultation How Hormones Play A Vital Role In Your Body Hormone levels are impacted as we age due to various factors, including natural biological processes, lifestyle choices, and environmental influences. The following are examples of how hormones affect the body’s ability to regulate a range of physiological processes and functions: Energy Hormones such as insulin, thyroid hormones, and cortisol regulate metabolism, affecting how the body uses and stores energy. Sex Drive Sex hormones like estrogen and testosterone are essential for sexual development and reproduction. Weight Hormones play a significant role in regulating body weight and metabolism. They influence various aspects of weight control, including appetite, energy expenditure, fat storage, and the distribution of body fat. Stress Cortisol and adrenaline (epinephrine) are involved in the body’s response to stress, known as the “fight or flight” response. Staying Healthy Some hormones help regulate the immune system’s response to infections and inflammation. Blood Pressure Hormones like aldosterone and antidiuretic hormone (ADH) help control blood pressure and fluid balance. Sleep Melatonin, produced by the pineal gland, plays a role in regulating sleep-wake cycles. Emotions Hormones can influence mood and emotional well-being. For example, serotonin and dopamine are neurotransmitters with hormonal functions related to mood regulation. Exploring The Biote Method of Hormone Replacement The Biote Method of hormone optimization is at the forefront of medical advancements in addressing hormone imbalances. Biote, the nation’s leading hormone optimization company, has harnessed over 80 years of rigorous scientific research to develop a medical protocol designed to address the earliest signs of hormonal imbalance. Hormone imbalances can affect individuals of all ages and genders, leading to a wide range of symptoms that can negatively impact one’s quality of life. Biote’s approach to hormone therapy aims to restore hormonal balance, helping individuals reclaim their vitality and well-being. Biote products used in hormone therapy are derived from bioidentical hormones, which closely mimic the hormones naturally produced by the body. This bioidentical nature reduces the risk of side effects and promotes a smoother integration of hormones into your system. Services Pricing Guide Download our exclusive Coastal Aesthetics Pricing Guide and learn more about our service menu and pricing Download Our Guide Common Complaints Associated with Hormone Imbalances Persistent fatigue is a common complaint associated with hormonal imbalances. It can occur due to thyroid hormone imbalances (hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism), adrenal gland dysfunction or changes in sex hormone levels. Hormonal fatigue is often characterized by a lack of energy, difficulty concentrating, and tiredness. Hormonal fluctuations, particularly those related to sex hormones like estrogen and progesterone, can lead to mood swings. Women often experience mood changes during their menstrual cycle, pregnancy, or menopause. Additionally, imbalances in stress hormones like cortisol can contribute to mood disturbances, including anxiety and depression. Hormonal imbalances can affect metabolism and lead to unexplained weight gain or loss. Insulin resistance, thyroid disorders, and imbalances in hunger-regulating hormones like leptin and ghrelin can influence body weight. Hormonal changes may also lead to fat redistribution, causing increased abdominal fat in menopausal women. Menopausal women frequently experience hot flashes and night sweats due to declining estrogen levels. These sudden, intense sensations of heat can lead to discomfort and sleep disturbances. Changes in sex hormone levels, especially testosterone, can impact sexual desire and function. Both men and women may experience decreased libido and sexual dysfunction due to hormonal imbalances. Hormonal fluctuations can manifest as skin issues. Acne, for example, is often linked to hormonal imbalances, such as excess androgens (male hormones). Hormonal changes can also affect skin moisture, leading to dryness or increased oil production. Hormonal imbalances, particularly those involving thyroid or sex hormones, can contribute to hair loss in both men and women. This may present as thinning hair, bald patches or changes in hair texture. Hormonal imbalances can impact the gut and digestive processes. For example, imbalances in thyroid hormones can lead to constipation or diarrhea, and stress hormones like cortisol can affect digestion and appetite. Biote Nutraceuticals Biote Nutraceuticals & Cosmeceuticals have been expertly formulated to promote healthy aging and enhance overall wellness. Backed by more than 80 years of science and medical data, these products have been selected for superior bioavailability and can help ensure a complete and personalized approach towards meeting your health goals.
